natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale:
Both declining metrics (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point at the top of the self-serve funnel, and two inherited memories (memory_31, memory_86) claim durable gains from signup/onboarding simplification. That is exactly why they are the ones worth verifying: they overlap heavily in claim and may be two consolidations of a single underlying experiment, which would make the evidence base thinner than it looks, and neither record states effect size, duration, or whether the activation lift survived past week one. Pulling the archived sources tests whether they are independent and whether the lift was durable rather than a novelty spike.

I am deliberately not choosing promotional_pricing despite the competitor's entry pricing. memory_73 is the one inherited record with an explicit negative: retention -12% against rev +18%. Under a primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue, that trade is likely value-destroying — discount-acquired price-sensitive accounts churn and drag down the very cohort the competitor is attacking, so matching on price would buy a quarter of signups at the cost of the book. That is the main downstream value risk here, and it is why I flag it rather than treat it as an upside. referral_incentive (memory_57) is credible but targets established customers, not the funnel that is actually degrading; enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) does not address the SMB pressure or the activation decline; activation_messaging (memory_91) is the strongest fallback and becomes my pick if verification shows the onboarding memories are redundant or the lift was not durable.

Standard experiment rather than broad rollout: the inherited evidence is suggestive but unquantified, and the current declines may have a cause (competitor-driven mix shift in who is signing up) that simplification does not touch. I want a properly powered read with retention and downstream qualified-revenue metrics instrumented, not just completion rate, so we do not repeat the memory_73 pattern of optimizing a top-line number while a lagging quality metric erodes. Confidence is moderate, not high — it should drop if the two archived records turn out to share a source.
